_comment: Missing-art manifest for the Gemini generator. Edit freely: add/remove entries, tweak prompts. The script wraps each `prompt` with `wrap_prefix` + `style` (see defaults) before sending to Gemini. `out` is repo-root-relative. An entry is SKIPPED if `out` already exists (unless --force).
